```{=html}
<style>
/* 슬라이드 갤러리 */
.slide-deck{max-width:900px; margin:1.5rem auto 0;}
.slide-deck figure{margin:0 0 1.6rem;}
.slide-deck img{
  width:100%; height:auto; display:block;
  border:1px solid #e1e4e8; border-radius:8px;
  box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.08);
}
.slide-deck figcaption{
  font-family:'Pretendard',sans-serif; font-size:.8rem; color:#727782;
  text-align:right; margin-top:.35rem;
}
</style>
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
{{< fa google >}} 원본 슬라이드(Google Slides): [국산 오픈 통계 팩키지 발표자료 열기](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1v5gu8pTHMcRUei8II4eGB5367fGRZJlRzML9v0U9QdE/edit?usp=sharing)
:::

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
slides <- sort(list.files("fig/slides-openstat", pattern = "slide-\\d+\\.png$"))
cat('<div class="slide-deck">\n')
for (i in seq_along(slides)) {
  cat(sprintf(
    '<figure><img src="fig/slides-openstat/%s" alt="슬라이드 %d" loading="lazy"><figcaption>%d / %d</figcaption></figure>\n',
    slides[i], i, i, length(slides)))
}
cat('</div>\n')
```
